```yaml
name: Lint and Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v3
    - name: Set up R
      uses: r-lib/actions/setup-r@v2
      with:
        r-version: "4.1"
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        Rscript -e 'install.packages(c("lintr", "styler"))'
    - name: Run lintr
      run: |
        Rscript -e 'lintr::lint_package()'

  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v3
    - name: Set up R
      uses: r-lib/actions/setup-r@v2
      with:
        r-version: "4.1"
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        Rscript -e 'devtools::install_deps(dependencies = TRUE)'
    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        Rscript -e 'devtools::load_all(); testthat::test_file("tests/testthat/test-huxtable-creation.R")'
```
